factor_info.label: Shootout or defensive battle
factor_info.rule: Counts whichever is stronger. Shootout: full at 54 total points. Defensive battle: full when the game stays within a score with 20 or fewer total points; turnovers and sacks add a little.

factor_info.label: Nail-biter
factor_info.rule: Share of the second half played within 8 points. Q4 and overtime count double.

factor_info.label: Lead changes
factor_info.rule: Full at 4 lead changes. Each tie counts as half.

factor_info.label: Upset
factor_info.rule: Full when a 9-point underdog wins, using the betting line. Without a line it uses form (point margin so far). A tie by the underdog counts half.

factor_info.label: Close finish
factor_info.rule: Full for a tie or 1-point margin, falling to zero at 24. Overtime adds 25%.

factor_info.label: Late winning score
factor_info.rule: Full when the winner went ahead for good in the last 2 minutes; less the earlier it happened. Overtime counts 125%.

factor_info.label: Comeback
factor_info.rule: Full when the winner came back from 14 points down.

factor_info.label: Big plays
factor_info.rule: Full at two touchdowns of 40+ yards.

factor_info.label: Defence / special teams scores
factor_info.rule: Full at 1.5 defensive or return touchdowns or safeties.

factor_info.label: Chaos
factor_info.rule: Fights and ejections count most, then taunting and unsportsmanlike conduct, then personal fouls. Full at about two ejections. Only what appears in the play-by-play is caught.
